title: LE7 auxiliary axisymmetric solid stress comparison (legacy scaled geometry)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE7 (target: axial stress 25.86 MPa on the outer surface at D, R = 1.0125, Z = 1.4034), as reproduced in the ESRD StressCheck Benchmarks Guide 'The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks: Linear Elastic Tests' (2018), p. 23, which also gives its converged axisymmetric solid result, 25.27 MPa (p. 24); the Abaqus 2016 Benchmarks Guide, section 4.2.7 'LE7: Axisymmetric cylinder/sphere under pressure', gives the target rounded to 25.9 MPa

quantities.quantity: axial stress σ_yy at D (1.0125, 1.4034), outer surface, against the converged solid model
quantities.reason: the same model idealisation (axisymmetric solid) as the reference, which ESRD reports converged to under 1% on two meshes; ours moves by 0.05% on the next refinement (see README)
